title.description: The title of a recipe, displayed to users

slug.description: The unique identifier for a recipe

prepTime.description: The time spent preparing to cook a recipe (minutes)

cookTime.description: The time spent cooking a recipe (minutes)

totalTime.description: The total time spent before food is ready to eat (minutes; includes prep, cooking, cooling, etc.)

ingredients.description: The components required to cook the recipe

quantity.description: The amount of the ingredient required for the recipe

unit.description: The measurement of the quantity required for the recipe

name.description: The common name of the ingredient required for the recipe

steps.description: The steps required to cook the recipe

nutrition.description: Nutrition information for the completed recipe

tags.description: Recipe tags, such as allergens, vegetarian, spiciness, kosher/halal, etc.
